# Only a copy from one slice to another becomes the copy builtin. Copying a
# slice onto itself does nothing and is left alone, and so is a slice of a type
# simd has no vector for: that is the set of element types loopvec handles.

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
! stderr .
! exists ops_simd.go
cmp ops.go ops.go.orig

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func SelfCopy(dst []float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = dst[i]
	}
}

func CopyStrings(dst, src []string) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = src[i]
	}
}
